name: my-07--kimi-k3-1-pro
question: Above what annual sales value must a manufacturer of taxable goods register for sales tax in Malaysia?
answer: A manufacturer of taxable goods must register for sales tax when the total sales value of those goods **exceeds RM500,000 in any 12-month period**. This is not limited to a calendar year. Specific exemptions or special rules may apply to certain goods or manufacturing activities.
